Selected Work

Case Studies

A closer look at three projects that challenged me to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

CASE STUDY 01
Redesigning the Used-Car Discovery Experience
Mahindra First Choice Wheels — mahindrafirstchoice.com

Users were abandoning the search funnel before viewing a single listing. Through moderated usability tests and session recordings, I uncovered that filter overload and unclear pricing labels were the primary culprits. I redesigned the search architecture and introduced progressive disclosure — reducing cognitive load and lifting listing views per session significantly.

CASE STUDY 02
Building Trust in Online Vehicle Auctions
Ediig Auctions — ediig.com

Online auction platforms struggle with a core trust problem: bidders can't touch the car. I led the end-to-end UX for Ediig's bidding interface, focusing on transparency signals — inspection scores, bid history timelines, and live countdown mechanics — that gave bidders the confidence to commit. The design system I built also enabled the engineering team to ship new auction types 40% faster.

CASE STUDY 03
A Health Dashboard That Motivates, Not Overwhelms
Concept Project — Mobile Health & Wellness App

Health apps often drown users in data with no clear next action. For this concept, I ran diary studies with 12 participants to understand how people actually interpret their fitness metrics. The resulting design uses a "one focus metric" home screen that adapts to the user's goal, surfacing only what matters today. Prototype testing showed users felt more motivated and less anxious after a week of use.

How I Work

My Design Process

A flexible framework I adapt to every project — rigorous where it matters, fast where it needs to be.

01
Discover
Stakeholder interviews, competitive audits, and desk research to frame the right problem before touching any design tool.
02
Define
Synthesise research into personas, journey maps, and a clear problem statement the whole team can rally around.
03
Ideate
Rapid sketching, How Might We sessions, and lo-fi wireframes explored in Figma to test many paths cheaply.
04
Prototype
Interactive hi-fi prototypes in Figma that feel real enough to test without writing a line of code.
05
Test & Iterate
Moderated usability sessions and A/B tests to validate, then iterate fast. Design never stops at handoff.
About Me

Jerome Antony

I'm an entry-level UX/UI designer based in Bangalore, India. I spent a year as a UX/UI Design Intern at Mahindra First Choice Wheels, owning end-to-end design for 5 live product releases on a large-scale automotive marketplace, from research through developer hand-off.

My background in Data Science (M.Sc, St Joseph College Trichy) and Business Analysis gives me an unusually analytical lens on design — I'm comfortable in a spreadsheet as much as a Figma canvas, which means I speak both the language of users and the language of metrics.

Outside work I'm curious about emerging design systems, accessibility standards, and the intersection of data and empathic design.
